The structure of Ca4Cr2Co8O16 (reduced formula Ca2Cr(CoO2)4) is monoclinic, space group C2/c (No. 15), with 30 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ca centers with eight O neighbors, Co centers with four O neighbors, and Cr centers with six O neighbors; O centers have four geometric neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 30 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner- and edge-sharing between 8-vertex Ca polyhedra, and corner-sharing between Ca 8-vertex and Cr 6-vertex polyhedra.
